## Results (key numbers)

**Proteome (notebook 08)**

- the 35th hit `zz_Y-FGCZCont00173_` is an FGCZ lab contaminant -> **34 real
  proteins** changed after 15 min: **27 up, 7 down** after PASN
- largest group up = fermentation / anaerobic metabolism (6): AdhE 18.2x, NrdD 7.7x,
  PflA 5.2x, Ldh1 4.6x, NrdG 3.7x, Adh 3.3x; they form the largest cluster in the
  STRING network
- also up: cell-wall hydrolases (SceD 4.9x, LytM 4.3x, IsaA 3.7x) and SepF;
  stress / regulation (PerR 2.2x, two cold-shock proteins, AraC regulator);
  three VOC / glyoxalase-family detox enzymes
- strongest decrease: delta-hemolysin (Hld) 8.1x lower after PASN (*agr* / RNAIII
  read-out); also the MHC class II analog protein (Q2FW51) lower
- 17 of 34 proteins are "conserved hypothetical" in STRING; 4 of them are truly
  unknown in both annotations
- on/off proteins (3/3 vs 0/3): 8 only in TSB, 8 only after PASN (e.g. glutathione
  peroxidase and MsrA lost after PASN; a MerR family regulator appears)
- 17 of the early proteins carry at least one phosphosite in the STYH data, but
  almost all estimates are `lod_imputed` and none passes the thresholds
- link to the papers: the 15 min pattern looks like the beginning of the 18 h
  response in Schwyter et al. 2025 (fermentation, oxidative stress, less virulence)

**Topic 2 (Michelle)**

- RpoY T21 (B7H15_05655, "hypothetical protein" in JE2, UniProt Q2FZG8 = RNA
  polymerase subunit epsilon): diff = +2.43 (higher in TSB = **lower** after PASN),
  FDR 0.003; protein unchanged (FDR 0.21). STRING partners: RpoA, RpoB, RpoC, RpoZ, SigA
- 5'-nucleotidase S33 (B7H15_01690, Q2G170): diff = −2.42 (**higher** after PASN),
  FDR 0.017; protein unchanged (FDR 0.78). S33 lies right after the predicted
  signal peptide (1–31). STRING partners: DeoD, DeoD-2, GuaB (purine metabolism, text mining only)
- IsaA S194 (B7H15_14290, Q2FV52): diff = −2.80 (**higher** after PASN), FDR 0.032;
  protein also higher (diff = −1.87, FDR 7e-8) -> mostly more protein, not more
  phosphorylation
- the 3 proteins belong to different processes (transcription, nucleotide
  metabolism, cell wall) -> no common pathway can be inferred from 3 sites

## Problems / surprises

- a lab contaminant was among the 35 "changed proteins" -> still to be removed in
  notebooks 07 and 08 (count = 34)
- JE2 annotation is often vague ("hypothetical protein"); the NCTC 8325 ortholog
  in UniProt / STRING gives more information (e.g. B7H15_05655 = RpoY)
- Q2FW51 is called "toxin" in JE2 but "MHC class II analog protein" in STRING -> check
- several hits are borderline (FDR 0.016–0.048): AraC regulator, BrnQ-like carrier,
  Q2FZA8, EssG, Q2G1V8, tautomerase
- AdhE 18x in 15 min is surprisingly large -> check whether it was near the
  detection limit in TSB
